item.title: Sudbury Polar Plunge 2026
item.description: Participants in the Sudbury Polar Plunge hit the icy waters of Ramsey Lake near the Northern Water Sports Centre in Sudbury, Ont. on Saturday, March 7, 2026. Held in support of Special Olympics Ontario, the event had topped its $50,000 goal as of Saturday and was close to raising $60,000 for SOO.
